Fix `.changeset/entity-rename-redirects.md` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 review: the changeset overstates hijacking protection. The sentence 'Redirects only happen when the former name is no longer used by another entity, when the claim comes from the same source as the former entity, and when exactly one entity claims the name.' presents the same-source rule as unconditional. Rewrite the last paragraph's rules for adopters: a redirect happens only when no entity currently uses the old reference, the claiming entity has the same kind, and exactly one entity claims the name; the same-source check applies only while the catalog still keeps a record of the former entity, and with the default orphan strategy ('delete') that record is usually removed soon after a rename, after which any single entity of the same kind can claim the name; if a second entity also claims the name, the redirect stops (the old link shows not found). Keep the permission sentence. Docs only, plain adopter language, no internal code symbols (no function, class or table names). Keep the frontmatter and the first two paragraphs unchanged.
